units.source_text: 然而，当时她着实可怜，温泉街的伯母就把她领了回来。

en.t: However, she was truly pitiful at the time, so her aunt from the hot spring town took her back with her.

units.source_text: 在小学校长等人多次催促之下，县政府才发表了表彰通知。

en.t: Only after repeated urging from the elementary school principal and others did the prefectural government issue the commendation notice.

units.source_text: 这时阿雪已经到了镇上的艺伎馆。

en.t: By then, Ayuki had already gone to the geisha house in town.
Her father, meanwhile, had gone to work in the mountains.
